messages:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — enterprise/vpc customer 'MeridianBank' experiencing elevated websocket streaming disconnects and upstream timeouts. Alert group: appgw-streaming. Pages sent to #oncall and paging roster. Logs: spike in 502/504 and ECONNRESET from upstream. Links: <https://ops.redwood.internal/alerts/3041600000|alert>

evan_sre: I'm on it, joining the call. Initial triage: failures correlate to dedicated-pool-5 (us-east-1-d) nodes talking to Meridian's backend IPs. Observed many short-lived streams dropping ~10–20s after open — looks like upstream closing connections; client retries create retry storms.

maria_ops: confirmed in logs: many 504 Gateway Timeout and RST packets from upstream LB. Error sample:
```
2026-03-15T15:02:11Z appgw[pool-5] upstream=10.101.3.45:443 status=504 duration_ms=30001
```
Affected scope seems single tenant (MeridianBank) on dedicated-pool-5. No broad cross-tenant alarms yet.

aj_devops: @evan_sre can you grab tcpdump from node-3 in pool-5 and check kernel tcp_retries2? Might be backend dropping idle connections or LB rate-limiting.

evan_sre: tcpdump snippet:
```
15:03:21.123456 IP 10.101.3.45.443 > 10.102.4.12.54832: Flags [R], seq 0, ack 0, win 0
```
Curl test to upstream hangs then RST:
```
$ curl -v --no-buffer "https://upstream-meridian.internal/stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED"
* Connected to upstream-meridian.internal (10.101.3.45) port 443 (#0)
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< transfer-encoding: chunked
* recv() returned 104, connection reset by peer
```

sam_support: CX (MeridianBank SRE) already reported degraded streaming in production. They see disconnects and spikes in client retries. They asked if we can throttle or provide a non-streaming fallback.

sylvia_se: We should avoid global changes. Suggest per-tenant mitigations: short-term disable long-lived streaming for Meridian and route to chunked poll fallback; also apply per-tenant connection caps so retries don't cascade to other tenants.

aj_devops: Proposed immediate mitigations:
1) Increase proxy upstream timeout to 90s for meridian routing — quick config change, low risk.
2) Apply routing rule to disable streaming and enable fallback poll endpoints for Meridian — needs edge rule patch + incremental deploy.
3) Add header to suppress client immediate retries: `x-rw-retry-policy: none` for Meridian via routing override.

maria_ops: I'll coordinate canary rollout. Plan: canary to 1/3 nodes, monitor 10m, then full.

evan_sre: I'll take on-call handoff from here. @aj_devops prepare config patch, @sam_support prep customer communication template with these mitigations. I'll monitor metrics and packet captures.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: edge-config-upstream-timeout=90s on dedicated-pool-5 (canary 1/3 nodes) — <https://deploys.redwood.internal/3041600000|details>

aj_devops: Applying route patch (canary):
```
PATCH /configs/routes/meridian
{
  "streaming_enabled": false,
  "upstream_timeout": 90,
  "headers": {"x-rw-retry-policy": "none"}
}
```
Rolling to canary node now.

maria_ops: Canary applied to node-7. Monitoring trace and token-level metrics.

evan_sre: Early results: retry rate down ~60% from peak for Meridian sessions on canary node. Error rate reduced ~45% on that node. No noticeable impact to other tenants. Good sign.

sam_support: Draft to Meridian SRE (please review):
"We observed elevated websocket disconnects. We've applied per-tenant mitigations: increased upstream timeout, temporarily disabled long-lived streaming in favor of a chunked-poll fallback, and suppressed immediate retries. These changes are canary-rolled and we're monitoring. We may request temporary changes on your backend if we see continued resets."

sylvia_se: Good. Also create a follow-up action: require Meridian to surface backend idle/keepalive configurations. We should add health-checks that treat long-lived streaming differently for enterprise VPCs.

aj_devops: Canary -> full rollout starting. Rolling to remaining 2/3 nodes with 30s spacing.

evan_sre: Observability post full rollout: stream disconnect alerts stopped on dedicated-pool-5. Aggregate retry rate back to baseline. No collateral regressions detected.

maria_ops: All nodes updated. Leaving enhanced logging for 2h. Monitoring dashboards: <https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/streams/meridian>

evan_sre: Root-cause hypothesis: Meridian's backend LB was aggressively terminating idle upstream connections on long-lived streams under load. That + client aggressive retries created a feedback loop at our gateway. Mitigation prevented retry storm and gave CX time to adjust backend LB.

sam_support: Meridian confirmed they rolled a backend LB config change (keepalive increased) and are validating. They asked for final confirmation before we re-enable streaming.

sylvia_se: Post-incident action items (to record):
- Postmortem ticket RWD-INC-3041600000 with timeline and RCA
- Add per-tenant streaming isolation runbook
- Add circuit-breaker for upstream closes to prevent retry storms
- Improve default upstream timeouts for enterprise VPC routes

evan_sre: Final status: 45m after full rollout, no streaming disconnect alerts. I'll keep monitoring for 2h before marking resolved. I'll open the postmortem and assign tasks.

maria_ops: Rolling back canary guard flags remains until CX confirms. Monitoring window 2h. :white_check_mark:

aj_devops: Thanks everyone. Good coordinated mitigation.

incident_bot: Incident 3041600000 — P1 mitigated. Will auto-resolve after 2h stable period. :white_check_mark:
